name: IpsoCheck
description: Run an ipso decision check and leave its SARIF file and verdict report for the pipeline to publish.
helpMarkDown: Linux and macOS agents only. The task installs ipso 0.4.0 after a sha256 check, or uses cli-path. It holds no Azure credential.
author: ipsofacto-io

inputs.name: command
inputs.label: Command
inputs.helpMarkDown: The engine check to run. One of plan, ci, checkov, snyk, wiz, sonarqube, dependabot, pulumi, cloudformation, arm, depcruise, semgrep, archunit, importlinter, kyverno, gatekeeper, or eslint.

inputs.name: args
inputs.label: Arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Arguments of that check, such as the plan file. They are split on whitespace and no shell expands them.

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: The ipso release to install, without the leading v. Only 0.4.0 is accepted.

inputs.name: cli-path
inputs.label: CLI path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path of an ipso binary already on the agent. The task then installs nothing and does not check a hash.
